description: This file defines a repository class for handling CRUD operations related to profiles in a database. It includes methods for creating a new profile record and retrieving a profile by its ID.

classes.name: ProfileRepository
classes.description: A repository class managing database interactions for profile entities, inheriting common functionality from BaseRepository.

methods.name: int create( self, user_id: int, platform: str, url: str, headline: Optional[str], summary: Optional[str], data_json: Optional[dict], )
methods.description: Creates a new profile record in the database with the provided user ID, platform, URL, and optional headline, summary, and data_json; returns the new profile's ID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get(self, profile_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a profile record by its ID and returns it as a dictionary.
